t: The Road to Simplicity: FastHTML, HTMX, and Pythonic Web Endpoints
s: This article explores modern Python web development, advocating for a shift from complex client-side JavaScript to server-driven interactivity using FastHTML and HTMX. It highlights the advantages of ASGI frameworks like Starlette and Uvicorn for efficient, Python-centric web applications.
